svg.title: Agentic Shiksha: Service architecture
svg.desc: Main React frontend and FastAPI backend, separate admin React frontend and FastAPI backend, and their shared managed dependencies. The admin UI also calls the main API for course placement and assignments. The admin API is not a proxy. Its access boundary must be independently authenticated and restricted; this figure is not a security-completeness claim. Source snapshot: 30 SEP 2026. Not a live deployment inventory.

g.text: Four independently built services, with explicit ownership of user experiences and APIs.
Learner chat / course builder / embedded teacher dashboard
Sessions / course access / chat / teacher routes
TA harness / material and curriculum workers
Four independent builds. Teacher views use the main API; the admin API is not a proxy for it.
